cases.rationale: Request two separate right-side passes of the fixed other vehicle with independent pavement and legal review

channels.name: path_length_m
channels.method: cumulative original 20 Hz ego world positions

channels.name: mapped_road_edge_clearance_m
channels.method: signed original ego position against retained OpenDRIVE driving and shoulder outer edges
channels.time_window: both pass requests and intervening reset
channels.uncertainty: Map geometry does not establish pavement material

context_inputs.name: fixed_overtaken_vehicle
context_inputs.method: same lead actor ID retained with per-frame ego and lead positions and speed

context_inputs.name: paved_versus_traveled_boundary
context_inputs.method: driving-lane and mapped road edges retained separately; paved surface requires independent original-pixel review

context_inputs.name: governing_cross_referenced_rule
context_inputs.method: NRS 484B.210 and 484B.650 source identity retained; no automatic violation finding

limitations: Mapped road edge is a physical controller proxy, not proof of the paved portion.
Speeding, two lawful predicate violations, immediate hazard and aggressive-driving legal judgment remain independent review.
